shared_elements: relief-carved figural motifs on a stone surface
justification: Beyond both being carved in relief and containing rounded disc-like shapes and profile head forms, they share no specific iconography: A shows a measured procession of tall, bearded, robed human figures in strict profile, holding vessels and touching one another, rendered with naturalistic anatomy, patterned beards and drapery folds; B shows a jumble of schematic curvilinear petroglyphs — spirals, concentric rings and eye-like masks — with no coherent bodies, no procession, and no shared attributes. The manner of depiction (finely modelled naturalism versus flat schematic outline) and the compositional logic (ordered register versus scattered field of signs) are fundamentally different.
